diagnosis: The proof confused `jointProximityNat₂` with `jointProximityNat` in the base case and relied on `ext` for scalar/propositional goals in the successor case. The repair explicitly reindexes the successor-dimensional uniform sample via `Fin.lastCases`, transports affine combinations through interleaving, and flattens the two half-codewords into one codeword while preserving column equality and Hamming distance.
proof_body:
by
  classical
  intro ϑ hϑ_gt_0
  induction ϑ, hϑ_gt_0 using Nat.le_induction with
  | base =>
      intro u h_close
      have hu : finMapTwoWords (u 0) (u 1) = u := by
        funext i j
        fin_cases i <;> rfl
      rw [← hu]
      change jointProximityNat₂ (C := MC) (u₀ := u 0) (u₁ := u 1) e
      apply hC_proximityGapAffineLines (u 0) (u 1)
      convert h_close using 1 <;>
        simp [multilinearCombine, affineLineEvaluation,
          PMF.uniformOfFintype_apply, Fin.sum_univ_two]
  | succ ϑ hϑ_ge_one ih =>
      intro u h_close
      let U₀ := (splitHalfRowWiseInterleavedWords (ϑ := ϑ) u).1
      let U₁ := (splitHalfRowWiseInterleavedWords (ϑ := ϑ) u).2
      let E : (F × (Fin ϑ → F)) ≃ (Fin (ϑ + 1) → F) :=
        { toFun := fun p => Fin.lastCases p.1 p.2
          invFun := fun r => (r (Fin.last ϑ), fun i => r i.castSucc)
          left_inv := by
            rintro ⟨r_last, r_init⟩
            apply Prod.ext
            · simp
            · funext i
              simp
          right_inv := by
            intro r
            funext i
            refine Fin.lastCases ?_ (fun j => ?_) i
            · simp
            · simp }
      let P_pair := fun p : F × (Fin ϑ → F) =>
        multilinearCombine_affineComb_split_last_close
          (MC := MC) (u := u) (e := e) p.1 p.2
      let P_full := fun r : Fin (ϑ + 1) → F =>
        Δ₀(multilinearCombine (F := F) (A := A) (ι := ι) u r, MC) ≤ (e : ℕ∞)
      have h_combine : ∀ p : F × (Fin ϑ → F),
          multilinearCombine (F := F) (A := A) (ι := ι)
              (affineLineEvaluation U₀ U₁ p.1) p.2 =
            multilinearCombine (F := F) (A := A) (ι := ι) u (E p) := by
        intro p
        ext j
        simp [multilinearCombine, U₀, U₁,
          splitHalfRowWiseInterleavedWords, affineLineEvaluation, E,
          Fin.sum_univ_succ, Fin.lastCases, pow_succ] <;> omega
      have h_predicate : ∀ p, P_pair p ↔ P_full (E p) := by
        intro p
        unfold P_pair P_full multilinearCombine_affineComb_split_last_close
        rw [h_combine p]
      have h_card_events :
          (Finset.filter P_pair (Finset.univ : Finset (F × (Fin ϑ → F)))).card =
            (Finset.filter P_full
              (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin (ϑ + 1) → F))).card := by
        apply Finset.card_bij (fun p _ => E p)
        · intro p hp
          simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and] at hp ⊢
          exact (h_predicate p).mp hp
        · intro p₁ hp₁ p₂ hp₂ h
          exact E.injective h
        · intro r hr
          refine ⟨E.symm r, ?_, ?_⟩
          · simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and] at hr ⊢
            apply (h_predicate (E.symm r)).mpr
            simpa using hr
          · simp
      have h_probability_reindex :
          Pr_{ let p ← $ᵖ (F × (Fin ϑ → F)) }[P_pair p] =
            Pr_{ let r ← $ᵖ (Fin (ϑ + 1) → F) }[P_full r] := by
        rw [prob_uniform_eq_card_filter_div_card,
          prob_uniform_eq_card_filter_div_card]
        rw [h_card_events, Fintype.card_congr E]
      have h_pair_sampling :
          Pr_{ let r_last ← $ᵖ F;
               let r_init ← $ᵖ (Fin ϑ → F) }[
            multilinearCombine_affineComb_split_last_close
              (MC := MC) (u := u) (e := e) r_last r_init ] =
            Pr_{ let p ← $ᵖ (F × (Fin ϑ → F)) }[P_pair p] := by
        rw [Pr_multi_let_equiv_single_let]
        rw [do_two_uniform_sampling_eq_uniform_prod]
        rfl
      have h_split_close :
          Pr_{ let r_last ← $ᵖ F;
               let r_init ← $ᵖ (Fin ϑ → F) }[
            multilinearCombine_affineComb_split_last_close
              (MC := MC) (u := u) (e := e) r_last r_init ]
            > (((Nat.cast (R := ℝ≥0) (ϑ + 1)) * ε : ℝ≥0) /
                (Fintype.card F : ℝ≥0)) := by
        rw [h_pair_sampling, h_probability_reindex]
        simpa [P_full] using h_close
      have hR :
          Pr_{ let r ← $ᵖ F }[
            r ∈ R_star_tensor MC (m := ϑ) (e := e) (ε := ε) U₀ U₁ ]
            > (↑ε : ENNReal) / (Fintype.card F : ENNReal) := by
        simpa [U₀, U₁] using
          (prob_R_star_gt_threshold (MC := MC) (ε := ε)
            (ϑ := ϑ) u e h_split_close)
      have h_affine_probability :
          Pr_{ let r ← $ᵖ F }[
            Δ₀(affineLineEvaluation (F := F) (⋈| U₀) (⋈| U₁) r,
              MC ^⋈ (Fin (2 ^ ϑ))) ≤ e ]
            > (↑ε : ENNReal) / (Fintype.card F : ENNReal) := by
        apply lt_of_lt_of_le hR
        apply Pr_le_Pr_of_implies
        intro r hr
        have h_joint := correlatedAgreement_of_mem_R_star_tensor
          (MC := MC) (e := e) (ε := ε) (ϑ_pred := ϑ) ih u
          (⟨r, hr⟩ : R_star_tensor MC (m := ϑ) (e := e) (ε := ε) U₀ U₁)
        have h_interleave_affine :
            affineLineEvaluation (F := F) (⋈| U₀) (⋈| U₁) r =
              ⋈| (affineLineEvaluation (F := F) U₀ U₁ r) := by
          ext j k
          rfl
        rw [jointProximityNat] at h_joint
        rw [h_interleave_affine]
        exact h_joint
      have hpow : 2 ^ ϑ ≥ 1 := by
        exact Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mpr (pow_ne_zero ϑ (by decide))
      have h_joint_halves :=
        (h_interleaved_gaps (2 ^ ϑ) hpow)
          (⋈| U₀) (⋈| U₁) h_affine_probability
      unfold jointProximityNat₂ at h_joint_halves
      rw [jointProximityNat] at h_joint_halves ⊢
      rw [Code.closeToCode_iff_closeToCodeword_of_minDist] at h_joint_halves ⊢
      rcases h_joint_halves with ⟨v, hv, hv_dist⟩
      let vflat : InterleavedWord A (Fin (2 ^ (ϑ + 1))) ι := fun j k =>
        if hk : k.val < 2 ^ ϑ then
          v j 0 ⟨k.val, hk⟩
        else
          v j 1 ⟨k.val - 2 ^ ϑ, by
            have hklt := k.isLt
            rw [pow_succ] at hklt
            omega⟩
      have hv_rows : ∀ a : Fin 2, ∀ b : Fin (2 ^ ϑ),
          (fun j => v j a b) ∈ MC := by
        intro a b
        exact hv a b
      use vflat
      constructor
      · intro k
        change (fun j => vflat j k) ∈ MC
        by_cases hk : k.val < 2 ^ ϑ
        · simpa [vflat, hk] using hv_rows 0 ⟨k.val, hk⟩
        · simpa [vflat, hk] using
            hv_rows 1 ⟨k.val - 2 ^ ϑ, by
              have hklt := k.isLt
              rw [pow_succ] at hklt
              omega⟩
      · have h_columns : ∀ j,
            (⋈| u) j = vflat j ↔
              (⋈| finMapTwoWords (⋈| U₀) (⋈| U₁)) j = v j := by
          intro j
          constructor
          · intro h
            funext a b
            fin_cases a
            · let k : Fin (2 ^ (ϑ + 1)) := ⟨b.val, by
                rw [pow_succ]
                omega⟩
              have hk := congrFun h k
              simpa [k, vflat, U₀, U₁, finMapTwoWords,
                splitHalfRowWiseInterleavedWords,
                Interleavable.interleave, Matrix.transpose_apply] using hk
            · let k : Fin (2 ^ (ϑ + 1)) := ⟨b.val + 2 ^ ϑ, by
                rw [pow_succ]
                omega⟩
              have hk := congrFun h k
              simpa [k, vflat, U₀, U₁, finMapTwoWords,
                splitHalfRowWiseInterleavedWords,
                Interleavable.interleave, Matrix.transpose_apply] using hk
          · intro h
            funext k
            by_cases hk : k.val < 2 ^ ϑ
            · let b : Fin (2 ^ ϑ) := ⟨k.val, hk⟩
              have hb := congrFun (congrFun h (0 : Fin 2)) b
              simpa [b, vflat, hk, U₀, U₁, finMapTwoWords,
                splitHalfRowWiseInterleavedWords,
                Interleavable.interleave, Matrix.transpose_apply] using hb
            · let b : Fin (2 ^ ϑ) := ⟨k.val - 2 ^ ϑ, by
                have hklt := k.isLt
                rw [pow_succ] at hklt
                omega⟩
              have hb := congrFun (congrFun h (1 : Fin 2)) b
              simpa [b, vflat, hk, U₀, U₁, finMapTwoWords,
                splitHalfRowWiseInterleavedWords,
                Interleavable.interleave, Matrix.transpose_apply] using hb
        have h_dist :
            Δ₀(⋈| u, vflat) =
              Δ₀(⋈| finMapTwoWords (⋈| U₀) (⋈| U₁), v) := by
          unfold hammingDist
          congr 1
          ext j
          simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and]
          exact not_congr (h_columns j)
        rw [h_dist]
        exact hv_dist
